problem.title: Find the Minimum and Maximum Number of Nodes Between Critical Points

approaches.title: Single-pass critical-point tracking
approaches.summary: Scan the linked list once while tracking the first and most recent critical points, the minimum adjacent critical-point distance, and the maximum distance between the first and last points. Later revisions simplify state management, traversal, and Rust ownership without changing the core strategy.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Introduced a one-pass scan that detects local extrema and tracks the first, recent, minimum-distance, and maximum-distance critical points.

revisions.commitComment: idiomatic improvements, and fix unintended double pass on first critical
revisions.rawCommitSubject: rust 2058: idiomatic improvements, and fix unintended double pass on first critical
revisions.shortChangeSummary: Fixed the first critical point being processed twice and simplified traversal using borrowed node references and sentinel distance values.
Removed an unnecessary maximum comparison because each newly found critical point is later than the previous one.
Eliminated explicit maximum-distance tracking and computed the final distance from the first and last critical points.

revisions.commitComment: taking rather than borrowing improves runtime
revisions.rawCommitSubject: rust 2058: taking rather than borrowing improves runtime
revisions.shortChangeSummary: Changed traversal to take ownership of each node and detach its successor instead of borrowing through the list.
Simplified the loop by handling the first successor separately and iterating directly while each current node has a next node.
